description: This file defines the 'Terms' result class for the Coocook schema, including columns, relationships, and methods for handling term validity and navigation.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Terms
classes.description: A class representing the 'terms' table with methods for managing term validity periods and relationships.

methods.name: cmp_validity_today
methods.description: Compares the 'valid_from' date with today's date, returning -1, 0, or +1 based on whether the term is in the past, today, or future.

methods.name: is_valid_today
methods.description: Checks if the term is valid today by comparing 'cmp_validity_today' result to 0.

methods.name: reasons_to_freeze
methods.description: Returns reasons why the term cannot be edited, such as being in the past or having associated users.

methods.name: reasons_to_keep
methods.description: Returns reasons why the term cannot be deleted, such as having associated users or being in the past/future with existing neighbors.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next valid term, default offset +1.

methods.name: previous
methods.description: Returns the previous valid term, default offset -1.

methods.name: neighbor
methods.description: Returns a neighboring term offset by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: neighbors
methods.description: Returns a set of terms before or after the current term depending on the direction.

methods.name: valid_until
methods.description: Returns the date until which the current term is valid, or undefined if no successor exists.
